criteria.text: Proposes deleting IL-23R in one population at a time, using the conditional allele with a T-cell driver and with an ILC3 driver.

grounding.quote: A conditional Il23r allele, a Cd4-Cre line and a Rorc-Cre line are all available

criteria.text: States the readout that separates the two explanations: the colitis score in each population-restricted deletion.

grounding.quote: a blocking antibody against IL-23 reduces disease

criteria.text: Notes that both populations express IL-23R, so expression cannot discriminate.
Explains that the Rag1-KO result shows ILC3s are sufficient but not that T cells are dispensable, which is why each population must be tested separately.

grounding.quote: the blocking antibody reduces disease in Rag1-KO mice, which have ILC3s but no T cells

criteria.text: Includes a control that keeps the comparison interpretable, such as the blocking antibody or a Cre-only arm.

grounding.quote: a blocking antibody against IL-23 reduces disease

criteria.text: Notes that a partial reduction in both arms would mean both populations contribute, and that the design can show this.
